items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: I mean we used to play together but Percy and him, at that time, we wasn't working, I was working with the old man.

ctx.x: You played with that player? I used to play with Willie and I used to play with the other brother too, he used to play. The saxophone. The saxophone. Yeah. He's playing now. Young Willie. Yeah, the old man and him. I mean we used to play together but Percy and him, at that time, we wasn't working, I was working with the old man.
I think Percy was a drummer for a while too, wasn't he? We haven't interviewed him. We interviewed the old man Willie and the young Willie too.
